FN-4UXCBRR-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 124
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/21/2026
Senate Bill 124 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Dauphin Island Sea Lab by
an undetermined amount to provide administrative support to the Alabama Seagrass Restoration
Task Force created by this bill. These obligations may be offset in part or in whole by the
retention of funds appropriated for administrative costs expended by the sea lab pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.

These obligations may be offset in part or in whole by the retention of funds appropriated for
